what: After linear arithmetic went in, `if k >= 1 && k <= v.len() { v[v.len() - k] }` was refused while the same guards nested passed: a fact that was entailed only through an implication (what `a && b` leaves) was never written into the state, and the linear proof reads the facts as written.
cause: two readers of one state with different views: `holds` follows implications, `known` lists facts
whys: the && form failed and the nested form passed
the fact was entailed, not stored
`assume` skipped storing what was already entailed
a second consumer of the state (the linear search) was added that reads storage, not entailment
class: two procedures over one state that disagree on what the state says
prevention: built: `assume` writes the fact down and `saturate` writes every implied conclusion whose premise holds; the Hegel oracle draws `&&` guards with linear sites
